integrity: The proof is analytic and dimension-uniform. The bundled exact-rational checker replays the matrix block decomposition and finite representative corollaries but is not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only strictly positive diagonal mixtures of the displayed nearest-neighbor basis in 2 by n. It does not classify coherent states on the same support, higher first-factor dimension, or negative-eigenvalue magnitudes.
title: Discrete log-concavity exactly controls partial-transpose inertia in a canonical qubit–qudit simplex
